daaf9b1d.r: While AI can monitor vitals and suggest dosage adjustments with high precision, the life-critical nature and procedural complexity of anesthesia require a human physician's judgment.

db3cf521.r: Physical guidance and clinical judgment are difficult to automate, but AI can enhance the process through computer vision for form correction and personalized recovery tracking.

dbf7ef7f.r: The scientific method and ethical oversight require human researchers, but AI can analyze vast datasets and draft literature reviews at unprecedented speeds. AI transforms the ability to identify correlations in health data.

e15edf82.t: perform a prosthetic examination of the patient
e15edf82.r: The physical examination and patient rapport require a human touch, but AI-driven 3D scanning and predictive modeling can transform the accuracy and speed of measurements and device selection.

e1e9a146.r: ICU work requires rapid, high-stakes human judgment and complex physical interventions. However, AI can transform the field by providing real-time predictive analytics for patient deterioration and personalized treatment suggestions.

e1fc1b9a.t: use e-health and mobile health technologies
e1fc1b9a.r: This skill is inherently tied to technology; AI will automate the data analysis portion while massively amplifying the provider's ability to monitor and treat patients remotely.

e2070f82.r: Requires human trust and coaching, but AI can provide 24/7 personalized data-driven strategies and reminders to the client.

e4dd9e52.t: monitor patients' progress related to treatment
e4dd9e52.r: AI can continuously monitor data streams for subtle changes, but the final decision to modify treatment requires clinical judgment and ethical responsibility.

e5912b5d.r: While AI can identify patterns and predict risks from data, the final accountability and complex decision-making in high-stakes healthcare environments require human judgment and empathy.

e5c36b84.r: Computer vision already matches or exceeds human performance in pattern recognition, though human oversight remains for final diagnosis and liability.

e5fe5be8.r: While AI can personalize learning materials and track progress, the mentorship and clinical context of healthcare education require human practitioners.

e67b2f64.r: AI can suggest referrals based on symptoms and data, but the professional responsibility and holistic understanding of patient needs remain a human clinical function.

e79ce1f0.r: While AI can predict drug interactions and molecular structures, the clinical application and regulatory responsibility require human medical judgment; however, AI massively accelerates drug discovery and personalized dosage calculations.

e7b1397e.r: While material selection involves complex regulatory and biocompatibility constraints that AI can optimize, the physical handling and custom fitting of these materials remain human-centric. AI significantly amplifies the ability to simulate material performance and discover new biocompatible alloys.

e802cf98.r: Massage requires high-dexterity physical touch and empathetic human response that AI and robotics cannot currently replicate.

e954f104.r: AI can effectively parse and summarize complex regulations, but applying them to specific, unpredictable physical environments remains a human responsibility.

e9764876.r: AI excels at pattern recognition in imaging and pathology, but final clinical diagnosis requires high-stakes human judgment and holistic patient context.

e9e20907.r: Clinical judgment and the empathetic relationship with patients are hard to automate. AI amplifies this by monitoring patient data and alerting providers to deviations from the recovery path.

eb5f29ec.r: Requires physical contact and empathetic patient interaction, but AI can assist in tracking patient progress and optimizing exercise regimens.

ee9369c8.r: While robotic phlebotomy exists, the need for patient empathy and navigating difficult veins keeps risk moderate; AI imaging can significantly amplify success rates by highlighting veins.

ef02a3a9.r: This requires high-dexterity physical manipulation of varied materials, which is difficult to automate, though AI can assist in the precision design of the alterations.

f017a329.r: Physical fitting and patient consultation are human-centric, but AI-driven generative design and 3D modeling can revolutionize the precision and speed of device creation.

f1f017de.r: Accountability is a fundamental human ethical and legal construct that cannot be offloaded to an algorithm.

f2d40cc6.r: Data entry and report generation are highly automatable, while AI can massively amplify the speed and depth of data analysis and pattern recognition.

f37fb288.r: Physical examination and patient handling are manual, but AI can significantly improve the speed and accuracy of hearing test data analysis.

f390478f.r: The high-stakes, physical nature of surgery makes automation risky, but AI can significantly amplify performance by identifying neural patterns and artifacts in real-time EEG data.

f8b49e0d.r: Theoretical kinetics is highly mathematical and suited for AI modeling, but applying it to real-world movement (robotics or sports) requires complex physical integration.

fa04a91e.r: AI can synthesize information and suggest novel solutions, but the final judgment and implementation in complex organizational contexts remain human-centric.

fa428b9f.r: Industrial plastic processing is largely automated, but bespoke or artisanal manipulation requires physical dexterity and material intuition.

fb0265a4.r: Requires precise physical manipulation and real-time patient feedback; AI can assist in point selection but cannot perform the physical procedure.

fbcd6a9b.r: AI can process patient data to suggest priority levels, but clinical judgment and physical observation remain critical for final triage decisions.

fc867442.r: AI can suggest remedies based on symptom databases, but the practice relies heavily on the patient-practitioner relationship and subjective consultation.

fd75f084.r: While AI can assist with scheduling and performance metrics, the core of leadership—motivation, conflict resolution, and mentorship—is deeply interpersonal.

fedf305d.t: develop plans related to client discharge
fedf305d.r: Discharge involves complex coordination and human empathy, but AI can drastically speed up the logistics, documentation, and resource matching.

ff6dcc19.r: High-stakes physical precision and real-time biological judgment make automation unlikely, but robotic assistance and AI imaging provide high leverage.
